body_markdown:
LAS VEGAS, NV (Nov 3, 2026) — Massimo officially launched the 2027 Warrior 1500XD and Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew at the 2026 SEMA Show, November 3 to 6 at the Las Vegas Convention Center (Booth #56217).


The launch follows the 1500 Series soft launch at Equip Exposition in October, where Massimo generated more than 100 prospective dealer leads.


Both vehicles are built around Massimo's new 1,499cc inline four-cylinder engine:


- **Warrior 1500XD:** rugged all-metal body, 29-inch all-terrain tires, a 10-inch touchscreen display, full-size crew seating and an integrated onboard cooler.
- **Sentinel 1500 HVAC Crew:** a fully enclosed cab with integrated heating and air conditioning, heated and cooled seating, an integrated cooler and four-door crew seating.


"The 1500 Series is about expanding what the Massimo brand can compete for," said Quenton Petersen, CEO of Massimo Group. "We believe we can offer customers serious power, technology and comfort without forcing them into the extreme pricing that has become common at the top end of the UTV market."


Massimo is also developing more 1500 Series configurations, including a Warrior HVAC model, a non-HVAC base model and two-door versions.
